**Significant language changes (new syntax, type-system or semantics changes)
should start in the Discussions tab, not as an issue: open a discussion first
so the design can be argued before any code is written.**

## Problem

What can you not do today, or what is painful? A short `.dr` snippet of the
code you wish you could write says more than a paragraph.

## Proposed solution

What you want to happen. For stdlib requests, name the module you would
expect it to live in.

## Alternatives

Workarounds you use today and why they fall short. Note that "Python has it"
is context, not a justification on its own: Dragon borrows Python's surface
only where it compiles cleanly to fast static code.
